title: fin.cap.lookup_transaction_history
description: Transaction history of one account within a time window. Pack data (noema#362): only the fields a caller supplies; additionalProperties false. SYNTHETIC.

account_ref.description: The account whose history is read (descriptor account.id).

from.description: Start of the window, inclusive, RFC 3339 UTC.

to.description: End of the window, exclusive, RFC 3339 UTC.
